definitions.gloss: quickly; swiftly; in one smooth motion
definitions.explanation: Describes a quick, smooth action performed without hesitation.
Describes doing something in a quick, light manner.

examples.japanese: さっと{手|て}を{洗|あら}った。
{野菜|やさい}をさっと{炒|いた}める。
{彼|かれ}はさっと{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
さっと{目|め}を{通|とお}しただけだ。
examples.english: I just skimmed through it quickly.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}がさっと{降|ふ}ってすぐ{止|や}んだ。
examples.english: It rained briefly and stopped right away.

notes:
さっと describes quick, smooth, effortless action — done in one clean motion without hesitation or fuss.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- さっと{読|よ}む: to skim through quickly
- さっと{済|す}ませる: to finish up quickly
- さっと{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry briefly
- さっと{目|め}を{通|とお}す: to glance through
- さっと{片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up quickly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぱっと: suddenly, in a flash (more abrupt, often visual — ぱっと{明|あか}るくなる)
- すっと: smoothly, quietly (gentler, more subtle movement)
- さっさと: briskly, without delay (implies impatience or efficiency; often used as a command)

USAGE:
さっと often implies a light, surface-level action: さっと{洗|あら}う (quick rinse, not a thorough wash), さっと{読|よ}む (skim, not a careful read). In cooking, さっと{茹|ゆ}でる means to blanch briefly.
